Wide 16:9 website cover, output 1920x1080 (at least 1600x900), high-resolution detailed pixel art.
Scene: a bright lab presentation hall set up like a friendly school contest. A large blank projector screen at the back center showing only simple bar and line shapes. Six colorful file folders (A to F shown only by six different tab colors, no letters) pinned in a row under the screen.
Left side, the red team with small red ribbons and a little red flag: anthropomorphic fruit fly researcher, black body, big red compound eyes, blue helmet with a gold stripe and pink and blue cables, white lab coat over a black vest, black gloves, transparent wings as team leader standing in front pointing at the screen; calm anime girl maid intern, long straight jet-black hair to the waist, calm gray eyes, small silver drop earrings, charcoal-black maid dress with white lace cuffs, white high collar with a large soft gray bow, long white frilled apron; girl researcher, long pink hair with two round buns and a navy streak, blue eyes, white lab coat over lavender hoodie, jeans holding a blank tablet; cute solid dark navy-black silhouette (#1B1A2E) with a thin purple rim light, white dot eyes, pink blush pixels, chibi silhouette with a round beret and short hair, round glasses whose lenses show two small teal (#3FC8C0) reflections as the only colored part.
Right side, the teal team with small teal ribbons and a little teal flag: boxy beige retro CRT-monitor robot, dark green screen face with mint pixel eyes and mouth, short antenna topped with a red-brown abacus bead, gray segmented arms, two small tank treads, holding a wooden abacus as team leader proudly raising its abacus; gentle cheerful anime girl maid intern, long ash-beige wavy hair, white frilled maid headband with a thin ribbon, big round amber-brown eyes, white shirt with a red and navy plaid bow tie, camel knit cardigan, white frilled apron, black skirt holding a clipboard; cute solid dark navy-black silhouette (#1B1A2E) with a thin purple rim light, white dot eyes, pink blush pixels, chibi girl silhouette with a long side ponytail tied with a big bright pink (#E9709A) bow as the only colored part; cute solid dark navy-black silhouette (#1B1A2E) with a thin purple rim light, white dot eyes, pink blush pixels, very small chibi silhouette wearing a hood with cat ears and an oversized lab coat, two hood drawstrings ending in small yellow (#F2C744) pompoms as the only colored part.
Center front, a small judge's desk with a purple armband: chibi scientist, thin teal rectangular glasses, spiky black hair with one white streak, small ponytail at the back, white lab coat over black vest and tie sitting as the referee, holding two small paddles, one red and one teal.
